Tuesday Men's Clubchangelog

How this site got the way it is, newest first. The entry says what changed; beside a few, a note says why, in the maker’s hand. “Considered options” opens what else was on the table.

  1. 2026-09-01

    The fall list drops September 1

    Once a session has met, its date leaves the list. The strip always reads forward.

  2. 2026-08-26

    Swan Song on the phone

    The mobile hero is George Byrne’s Swan Song, matching the session card and Luma. Desktop keeps the chairs; the credit sits in the footer, mobile only.

    considered options
    • H1The huddle still, bigger titlepicked 8/26, superseded
      The orphaned purpose-shot mobile asset; the title up to 18vw.
    • H2Swan Songpicked 8/26
      One image across the card, the calendar, and the phone.
  3. 2026-08-26

    The session card in the house palette; Bricolage everywhere

    Cream ground, dark text, red accents; the divider rule goes. Arial gives way to Bricolage Grotesque site-wide, matching the flyers.

  4. 2026-08-26

    Men, join us.

    The tagline. The fall run extends through December 15.

  5. 2026-08-24

    The fall schedule, on the homepage

    A plain static list of the fall run near the Next Session box: scannable, and it survives iframe-blocking. The meta description stops saying February.

    considered options
    • AFront the fall schedulepicked 8/24
      Static text is what search and link previews actually read.
    • BPrune the drifted pagespicked 8/24
      Retire why, helpful-things, links, materials, sessions behind redirects; refresh field-trips instead of pruning it.
    • CRefresh testimonialspicked 8/24
      Fold into About; source new quotes from the S36 asks-and-offers.
    • DTell the sixteen-months storypicked 8/24, later turned off
      One story, one home, linked from About.
    Content refresh, not rethink.
    JC, 8/24
  6. 2026-08-24

    Prune the drifted pages

    why, helpful-things, links, materials, and sessions retire behind redirects. Field trips is refreshed as its own home instead of pruned.

  7. 2026-08-10

    Register is the Luma page

    Register goes to the Luma calendar site-wide; register.html becomes an instant redirect so old links and QR codes keep working. The email list stays its own door.

  8. 2026-08-04

    RSVP on the hero; the calendar on Details

    The hand-edited Upcoming lists give way to the self-updating Luma embed. An RSVP button on the session box, patched per session.

  9. 2026-08-03

    TMC keeps a plain-text Elsewhere row

    The tile row the other sites took is reverted here to a line of words. “A JC Cangilla project” goes.

    considered options
    • E1The tile row, like the other sites
      Borrowed faces for each property.
    • E2A line of wordspicked 8/3
      The poster site stays a poster.
    TMC doesn’t need any of these.
    JC, 8/3
  10. 2026-06-16

    The Sessions page leaves the nav

    Kept at its URL, out of the nav. Summer Wende sessions added; the spring flyer comes down.

  11. 2026-06-11

    The homepage form writes to a sheet

    The dead Kit popup is replaced with a Google Sheets endpoint. The roster of record stays the sheet.

  12. 2026-06-04

    Elsewhere joins the footer

    A row linking the other four properties on every page, where before there was only an attribution line.
